reviews.text: I’ve been coming to Wilmer since 2017 when I moved to Vegas. Loyal to him and his shop! My mustache line up is always perfect. No need to go anywhere else !

I was visiting Las Vegas and came in for a much needed fade and beard trim. Hands down the best haircut I’ve ever gotten (which makes me sad being all the way in Massachusetts). Next time I’m back in Vegas W&W is my first stop!

Best customer service ever, very friendly staff, they even accept me without appointment and they give u free water, energy drinks and coffee if needed, i will comeback every week, and adrian best barber ever!
